input.summary:
P3 living room lamp: one standing lantern written at (52,2,16) in parts/room-23.mjs, but runParts refuses it (shell-west claims the room air as air, so the lock blocks every write there). make.sh exits 0 and builds build.nbt; the room is at min 7, mean 9.3, 0 dark, 2 dim cells (54,14) and (54,20).
Hearth answer: yes. The lit campfire at (50,1,17) lights the west column through the mouth at (51,1..2,17): x52 reads 9-C across z14..20, and the tool's numbers match a 15-level source spread through that mouth.
Nothing else touched; the lamp line is kept so it lands once the lock is lifted.
left: The lamp at (52,2,16) is refused by runParts (parts-report.json: 1 refused, 'lantern' wanted, 'air' had). The room is not lit to 8+ yet: two dim cells remain at (54,14) and (54,20), level 7.

Root cause is upstream, not in the lamplighter's part: shell-west.mjs line 16 fills every plot's inner air with air, and runParts locks air cells, so every furnishing write in room-23 (and room-1, the other rooms' designers too) is refused. Fix: shell-west leaves room air unclaimed, or the lock lets furnishing parts write into air. Owner decides; I did not edit the shell or runParts.
Once the lock lifts, the lamp at (52,2,16) needs the floor block at (52,1,16), which is oak_planks and present. Re-run ./make.sh and `mcd room --only "P3 living room"` to confirm 0 dim cells.

The designer's layout (sofa on x54, table x53 z16, hanging centre lantern) is still unbuilt and refused; the lamp position (52,2,16) does not conflict with it, but the designer should confirm the hanging lantern is still wanted.

waste.what: Looked up single blocks one by one (campfire state, cells above and below the lamp spot, the hearth mouth) with ad-hoc node scripts
waste.cost: about 4 probe scripts and 3 reruns of make.sh
waste.tool: A `mcd cell build.nbt x,y,z ...` command (or `mcd info --at`) that prints the block, state and whether the cell is locked by an earlier part

waste.what: Found the lamp was refused only after writing it and rebuilding; the room report still said OK and suggested the same refused lantern spot
waste.cost: 1 edit, 1 make.sh run, 1 room check to learn the lock refused the write
waste.tool: `mcd room` (or runParts' preflight) should flag cells that a part's lock will refuse, so a lamp spot inside shell-claimed air shows as LOCKED before the write

waste.what: Worked out the hearth's light path (campfire 15 -> mouth -> x52 at 12) by hand to answer the designer's question
waste.tool: `mcd light --source <x,y,z>` to show which lit sources reach a room's cells, with the light each contributes

companions.task: Shell-west owner: stop filling the room's inner air with air (shell-west.mjs line 16), so furnishing parts can write into the room; or confirm the lock should let furnishing parts write into air. Without this, no lamp or furniture in any room lands.
Confirm the P3 living room layout (sofa, table, hanging centre lantern) is still wanted once writes are possible again, and move the standing lantern if it clashes with the table.
